Composition/framing: square image, single full character centered and entirely visible, fills 80 to 85 percent of the frame height, generous clear padding on every edge. Long silhouette, clear hand shape. Three-quarter frontal view. No surrounding environment.
Lighting/mood: restrained cinematic cold rim light and warm directional key reveals the physical texture; genuine atmospheric dread, no cartoon outlines, no neon illustration.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha, absolutely no background, no checkered fake transparency, no opaque rectangle, no ground shadow.
Constraints: no blood or gore, no franchise character, no weapon, no text, no logos, no pedestal, no scene, no extra objects or figures, no cropped edges. This is emphatically R horror sophistication, not Halloween clip art or a preschool ghost.
